Subject: Project Update: New Delivery Date of 14 April

Dear [Client Name],

I'm writing to update you on the timeline for your project. The third-party integration required for the platform took longer to certify than expected, as the certifying body's review process ran past its original schedule. This has pushed the overall timeline back by two weeks.

The revised delivery date is now 14 April. Our team is continuing to work through the remaining steps in parallel where possible to keep the impact to a minimum, and we'll keep you posted on progress in the lead-up to that date.

Does this new date work with any commitments or launch plans on your end, so we can flag anything that needs closer coordination? Please let me know, and I'm happy to jump on a call if that would help.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
